_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: celtic (goidelic) backbone + classical (latinate) overlay (cross-family blend, Celtic-leaning)

blend.backbone: celtic (goidelic register: ri/ruiri/ard-ri, tuath and cland, the Mac-/O- patronymic, the brithem-judge and the fili-poet, initial consonant mutation, broad-slender consonants, root-initial stress)
blend.overlay: classical (latinate: the urbs/oppidum cities, the via road-net, the law and the senate, the rex/consul/comes civic register, -us/-a/-um endings, penultimate stress, the togate municipal populace)
blend.lean: Celtic-heavy - a Goidelic clan-aristocracy (a ruiri and his ri-kin) ruling over the Latinate civitas-towns of a Romanized province: the Celtic war-clans rule by tuath and fine, while the Roman road, the law, the forum and the city-charter are kept and serve beneath. Roman Gaul and Roman Britain - the British and Gaulish clans Romanized.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_02 the Celtic base (Insular, Goidelic-leaning) x BASE_06 the Agrippan/Latinate base (Classical). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Celtic base = Clanhold, Classical/Latinate base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Latbria is Civilized (feudal). Concept: the iconic Romano-Celtic / Gallo-Roman fusion - the Celtic clan-aristocracy of a conquered province taking on Roman roads, law and city life, the native ri and tuath enthroned over the Latin civitas-towns (Roman Gaul and Roman Britain). Backbone = Celtic (GOIDELIC: the ruling clan-aristocracy, the ri/ruiri/ard-ri register, the Mac-/O- patronymic, the brithem and the fili; Goidelic chosen as the project's default Celtic reflex); overlay/substrate = Latinate (the urbs/oppidum civitas-towns, the via road-net, the law and the senate, the Latin-named municipal populace, the rex/consul/comes civic register). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gaelic and Latin registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY from family_celtic theonym_set, Latinate variants SECONDARY morphed via agrippan - and because agrippan IS the canon's home register, its forms are near-canonical), never real Celtic/Roman gods. PROVISIONAL: alignment is a per-hybrid design choice pending the alignment pass - the Celtic clan-honor-and-oath order meets the Roman law-and-senate tradition; both read Lawful comfortably, the older heathen clan-and-grove layer reads Neutral. Register choice: Celtic-base hybrids default to the GOIDELIC reflexes (Latbria's ruling clans are Gaelic; a Brythonic sub-palette is available in family_celtic if a British register is wanted - flag for Jedidiah). Dual register: Goidelic clan rulers (Conn-, Domnall-, Mac-, -an); Latin names for the municipal populace (the -us/-a/-ius gens stock). [BUILT 2026-06-27 under the new-schema conventions: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved foreign term), conlang titles in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue; deities are the canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Celtic (Goidelic) backbone - initial consonant mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh/v, m>mh/v, t>th, d>dh; nasalization), broad vs slender consonants, root-initial stress, vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped in data), the Mac-/O- patronymic and the -an/-in diminutive - meeting a Latinate overlay: vowel-rich a e i o u, liquids l/r, sibilant s, f/v, the -us/-a/-um/-ius endings, penultimate stress, c=k, geminates ll/ss/tt. Per the CSV: a balanced rhythm carried on liquid consonants (the Goidelic l/r and broad-slender flow over the open Latin syllables); grammar is SVO with case-inflections preserved and the Goidelic initial mutations retained at word-boundaries. Theophoric on the Goidelic god-reflexes (Toran-, Orlann-) with Latinate variants (Tulrian-, Orland-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Goidelic mutation-driven clusters and broad-slender pairs meeting Latinate onset clusters (st tr pr cl sp) and geminates ll/ss/tt; root-initial Celtic stress with a Latinate penultimate pull on the civic stock; Goidelic Dun-/Rath-/Baile- compounds beside -um/-ia civic toponyms and Castra-/Forum- compounds.

sound_changes: Latin case-endings drop or take a Goidelic ending: final -us/-um/-a>0, or a kept Latin root takes Goidelic -an/-ach (campus>magan, vicus>fichan, ferrum>iarach)
Latin c=k stays hard but lenites Goidelic-fashion intervocalically/word-final (c>ch, t>th, b>bh/v, m>mh/v); Latin v>b/f; geminates ll/ss/tt simplify
Goidelic root-initial stress replaces the Latin penult; the broad-slender split and l/r liquid flow govern every root
Latin penult/short-vowel medials syncopate to a CVC Goidelic shape; -ia/-io>-e, -or>-ar
retain Goidelic mutation-clusters, the fada-less a e i o u, and slender/broad pairs; very short Latin roots take a Goidelic -an/-ach
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/civic/material/staple words from Latin roots (the Romanized substrate keeps the road, the city, the law-town and the trade-goods: via, urbs, forum, ferrum, vinum, frumen); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Goidelic roots (the ruling clan-register: mor, sean, ard, ri, fine, fian); every root then filtered to one Goidelic phonology so the join is inaudible

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Latin land/civic/material/staple roots + Goidelic kin/quality/rule/war roots, all run through one Goidelic-shaped sound-law (Latin endings dropped or taking -an/-ach, lenition, broad-slender, root-initial stress over the Latin penult); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. One word per concept, no slash-pairs.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Goidelic ruling clans keep the Mac- (son of) and O-/Ua- (descendant of) patronymic with the fine (kin-group) and cland (wider clan); the Latinate municipal populace keep the inherited gens (clan) name as a middle element (Marcus VALERIUS) and the filius- son-of frame; the throne fuses both - a ruiri who also bears a borrowed civic gens or a chartered cognomen.
morphology.compounding_rule: Goidelic feature-compounding ([quality|feature|saint](stem) + element with initial mutation: Dun-derg, red-fort; Ard-mor, great-height; Cill-[name], church of) layered over Latinate civic compounding (feature/adjective + civic suffix, eliding before a vowel: Castra-Brigant, the Brigant-clan fort; Forum-Orlann): the capital Latbria (the Goidelic clan-seat over the Latin land), the old urbs kept under its Latin name.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Goidelic clan-aristocracy over the Latinate civitas-towns: the ruiri and his ri-kin at the crown, the ri-tuaithe set over the petty kingdoms, the toisech-chiefs and flaith-lords sworn to the cland; the Latin senatus, the comites and the consular law-courts of the chartered cities preserved and serving beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Goidelic ladder, ascending, with the Latinate civic substrate co-titles beneath. Flaith (noble-lord) barony; Toisech-criche (border-chief) march, beside the Latin Limitanus of the chartered frontier; Toisech (clan-chief) county over a Toisecht, with the Latin Comes co-title for the conquered civitas; Tigerna (lord; *tigernos) duchy, beside the Latin Dux; Ri-tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality over a Tuath, beside the Latin Princeps; Ruiri (over-king) kingdom over a Ruirecht, styled Rex by the senate and the Latin chancery; Ard-ri (high king; Goid. ard-ri) empire over the Ard-ruirecht, styled Imperator when he wears the imperial purple of fallen Agrippa. The chartered cities keep their Latin Consul, Senatus and Comes beneath the Goidelic crown. The brithem (judge) and fili / ollam (poet-sage) stand outside the ladder, beside the Latin Pontifex and Praetor. Rank titles fuse the real Gaelic and Latin registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Tanaiste (the designated heir; the second-in-line of the cland), styled Caesar in the Latin chancery
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Goidelic ruling stock carry a personal name + Mac-/O- patronymic or fine/cland; the Latinate municipal populace carry the tripartite praenomen + gens + cognomen (or, for commoners, praenomen + occupational byname); order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Goidelic clan-aristocracy keep personal names + Mac-/O- patronymics (Conn mac Domnaill, Niall ua Brigant); the Latinate city-folk keep the gens-and-cognomen names (Marcus Valerius, Aurelia Cornelia) on the morphed canon-stems; the throne often carries both - a Goidelic ruiri who also bears a chartered civic gens.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Goidelic devotional on the canon-reflexes (Toran-, Mael-Orlann 'devotee of Orlann', Gilla-Toran 'servant of Toran'); Latinate theophoric praenomina on the morphed canon: Tulrian (of Tulrius/Toran), Orlandus, Realtus, Numenius.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Celtic Goidelic reflexes PRIMARY (family_celtic theonym_set, the Insular-Celtic forms), Latinate variants SECONDARY (the agrippan/Latinate canon forms, which are near-canonical because agrippan is the canon's home register), never real Celtic/Roman gods. Alignment PROVISIONAL (Lawful/Neutral): the Celtic clan-honor-and-oath order meets the Roman law-and-senate tradition.
religion.the_one: Eternan (Goidelic; Lat Aeternus) - the distant Ancient One, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Toran (Lat Tulrius) - the sun, fire and justice
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numan (Lat Numeno / Numenius) - sky and law-wisdom

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan, Toran the just, Orlann of the sworn war, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers fomoir (demons), warded and unworshipped; the clan-oath of the fine and the law-stele of the senate bind alike, and the just ruiri rules by both
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral clan-dead (the sinsir of the ruling cland) and the city-genii (the Latin genius loci of the urbs); the great powers invoked at the nemed-grove and the templum situationally rather than worshipped wholesale
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Eternan - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as fomoir (Goidelic demons) rather than worshipped, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Brand (Lat Maraxus the Tyrant-Flame); Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker (Lat Vacidus the Unmaker); Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm (Lat Lusento the Coin-Serpent).
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (Goidelic sacred grove) or Templum / Collegium (Latinate) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran', 'the Collegium of Tulrius'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified clan-dead (the noble sinsir of the ruling cland, honored at the cairn and the nemed) and the Latin Divus/Diva (deified founders and law-givers of the chartered cities, inscribed on the senate-stele).

holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a sun-disc over a crossed sword and law-stele
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron sword crossed with the legion-eagle
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaian: the ploughed mag beneath the city-wall

banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen ring-forts and the old Agrippan ruins: 'the Rath of Dun-[name]', 'the Sunken Forum', 'the Cairn of the Brigants', 'the broken Arx'
